headline: Expanse Still Burns as Row and Shelf Fall Quiet
war_summary: Since the 06:10 edition the front has shifted south to the Expanse while the Row and Shelf have fallen silent. The Weathered Expanse logged two changes in the last two hours to 09:10 for thirty-five on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, now standing four Colonial, four Warden with one neutral, with more than twenty-two thousand casualties in the day and loss rates still accelerating. Fisherman's Row recorded no changes in the last two hours, holding nine Colonial after twenty-five on the day about Black Well, Eidolo and Arcadia, last turning at 06:31. Stlican Shelf likewise shows none in two hours, holding eight Warden to one Colonial after thirty-two on the day about Fort Hoarfrost, The Old Mourn and The Pale House, also last turning at 06:31. Godcrofts, Stonecradle and Linn Mercy have gone quiet after forty, twelve and eight changes on the day respectively, while Callahan's Passage and Mooring County remain without a flip despite more than seventeen thousand and ten thousand casualties in the day respectively, both with casualty and enlistment rates accelerating.
